_source: https://badges.untappd.com/ — public Untappd badge catalog, BEER BADGES category (style-pack and country/region-pack badges), fetched 2026-09-12
_note: Two arrays: 'style_badges' (earned by checking in N DISTINCT BEERS matching one or more specific Untappd beer STYLE strings) and 'country_badges' (earned by checking in N DISTINCT BEERS from breweries in one or more specific COUNTRY/REGION names). Each entry's 'styles' or 'countries' array lists the exact style names / country-region names from the badge's own 'How to earn it' text on its detail page (https://badges.untappd.com/[id]-[slug]). 'count' is the number of distinct qualifying beers needed per tier; nearly all of these badges are repeating 'type_pack' badges that level up indefinitely by the same increment each time ('levels' = max level shown on the catalog, typically 100) — level 1 requires 'count' distinct beers, and each subsequent level requires 'count' MORE new distinct qualifying beers (not cumulative beyond that). The 8 'Super Style: ...' badges are the one exception: they are gated behind an active Untappd Insiders subscription, the FIRST qualifying beer alone earns level 1, and every 5 additional unique beers earns the next level — see their 'note' fields. Icon URLs are taken directly from each badge's own detail page (format https://assets.untappd.com/badges/bdg_*.jpg or assets.untappd.com/promo/*), matching the venue-badges file's convention. Country/region names are given as written in each badge's own text (Untappd's own country_name values are usually an exact or near-exact match, e.g. 'Mexico', 'Germany'; a few badges match a REGION spanning many countries, e.g. 'Central America' or 'the Caribbean' — those list every named country/territory). SKIPPED (not included below): (1) VENUE-category badges — already covered by badge_venue_categories.json; (2) purely social/frequency/meta badges (streaks, friend counts, level-up-by-any-beer badges, total-unique-beer-count badges like Elite/Epic/Uber, etc.); (3) one-off special-edition / brewery-collab / festival / date-window badges that check in a SPECIFIC named beer or brewery list rather than a generic style or country (e.g. Firestone Walker/Wicked Weed/Vault City/Top Rated Box/Punchtöberfest/cycling-route badges, and the time-boxed 'Belgian Beer Badge' and 'Celebrate Oktoberfest (2026)', which duplicate the evergreen 'Belgian Holiday' and 'Oktoberfest' badges already listed here); (4) badges keyed on beer ATTRIBUTES other than style or country of origin — IBU (Hopped Down/Hopped Up), ABV (Middle of the Road, Riding Steady, Sky's the Limit), or time/venue/frequency behavior (Taste Crazy, Wheel of Styles, Beer Connoisseur, Beer of the World, Beer Melting Pot); (5) badges keyed on a curated BREWERY LIST rather than a style or country (Cheers to Independent U.S. Craft Breweries, Pride365, Trappist Travesty, Untappd Groupie); (6) badges keyed on Untappd SERVING STYLE (Bottle, Can, Draft, Growler, Crowler, Cask, Nitro, Tank, Taster, Side Pull) rather than beer style, and (7) 'Home Brewed Goodness' (only 2 check-ins of the ambiguous 'Homebrew' category, not a real style/country match). See '_excluded_examples' at the bottom of each section for a representative (non-exhaustive) list of what was screened out this way. UPDATE 2026-09-14: reconciled every style_badges styles string against 306 real Untappd style strings observed across two heavy connected accounts (53k+ combined check-ins) - 9 entries used outdated/reworded style names that never substring-matched the live taxonomy (mostly pre-"Category - Subcategory" renames, e.g. "American Brown Ale" -> "Brown Ale - American", "Russian Imperial Stout" -> "Stout - Russian Imperial"), fixed to the exact live strings. A handful of remaining entries (Historical Beer - Berliner Braunbier, Blonde Ale, Sorghum/Millet Beer, Happoshu, Broyhan, Kuit / Kuyt / Koyt, Zoigl, Slushie) found no match in that 306-string sample either way - left as-is (unconfirmed either wrong or just genuinely rare/absent from both accounts, not reverified against Untappd directly). CORRECTION 2026-09-14: the 2026-09-14 reconciliation pass wrongly "fixed" Hella Delicious!'s second style from "Bock - Maibock / Heller (Helles) / Lentebock" to "Bock - Hell / Maibock / Lentebock" based on a false-positive fuzzy word-overlap match (both share 3 of 4 words with an unrelated real style) - reverted after a live badge_description straight from Untappd (fetched via get_my_profile) explicitly confirmed the ORIGINAL phrasing was correct all along (the style just had zero matching beers in the sample used for reconciliation, not a wrong name). CORRECTION 2026-09-14 (part 2): also reverted 3 more manual (non-fuzzy-script-confirmed) guesses from the same 2026-09-14 pass - Old is New (Old Ale, not Old / Stock Ale), Oat of this World! (Stout - Imperial Oatmeal, not Stout - Imperial / Double Oatmeal), Zwickel City (Zwickel / Kellerbier, not Kellerbier / Zwickelbier) - none of these had either an exact word-reorder match or a systematic sibling-pattern confirmation (unlike the Non-Alcoholic/Wild Ale/Brown Ale fixes, which are kept), and one near-identical-reasoning guess (Hella Delicious!) was proven wrong by a live badge_description, so these were reverted rather than left as unverified. UPDATE 2026-09-14 (exact-match markers): confirmed live (Session Life showed level 93 vs real 86 - 40 extra beers from the DIFFERENT real style "IPA - Session New England / Hazy" being substring-matched by catalog style "IPA - Session") that a catalog style already shaped like a complete real "Category - Subcategory" leaf name can wrongly also match a MORE SPECIFIC sibling real style that extends it with extra words (not a parent/umbrella relationship - two independent leaf styles that happen to share a text prefix). A "=" prefix on a styles[] entry (e.g. "=IPA - Session") now means EXACT match only, not substring - added to Session Life (confirmed) and all 5 "Super Style: X" badges (each names exactly one specific leaf style by construction, never a parent/umbrella term - high confidence by naming convention, not guesswork). Also fixed "Super Style: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy" whose styles[] entry was truncated (missing "/ Hazy") to the exact real string. Three more badges have the same theoretical risk (Fruits of Your Labor/"Sour - Fruited", To The Port/"Porter - Imperial / Double", Tripping on TIPAs/"IPA - Triple") but are ordinary (non-Super-Style) badges where broad-vs-exact intent cannot be inferred from naming convention alone and has not been live-confirmed either way - left as plain substring matches rather than guessed.

style_badges.note: Matches ANY style name containing the substring "Imperial / Double" (e.g. IPA - Imperial / Double, Stout - Imperial / Double). Untappd explicitly excludes Doppelbock even though it is colloquially an imperial-strength style.

Hopped Down / Hopped Up (IBU threshold, not a style)
Middle of the Road / Riding Steady / Sky's the Limit (ABV threshold, not a style)

Wheel of Styles (any 5 different styles — no specific target style)
Beer Connoisseur / Beer of the World / Beer Melting Pot (countries/regions counted generically, not one target country)
